summary: The v3 guide projection is decision-complete and testable for all fourteen acceptance criteria. TC-01 and GEV-02 now close the authorized observation ordering requirement with explicit pre-routing denial sentinels. TC-02, TC-04, TC-07 and GEV-02 keep a valid observation-routing snapshot while independently denying current write authority, distinguish provider observation reads from write/effect seams, and prohibit snapshot provenance from satisfying write authorization, closing GR-002 and GR-003. TC-06 and GEV-03 provide independent closed rows for unavailable, timeout, malformed/unknown and not-found HTTP 202 outcomes, closing GR-004. The remaining cases cover PostgreSQL-time takeover and generation fencing, terminal finalization, same-identity retry and crash recovery, independent SQLite persistence/audit reconstruction, candidate verification, and the static-registry/no-plugin/no-vendor boundary without expanding into Issue #79 or implementation authority.
